name: harness-mrtool
description: Deterministic GitLab merge request workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Create verified GitLab merge requests from repository changes.
interface.longDescription: Uses the harness-mrtool CLI to gather live GitLab context, automatically create or update and verify managed merge requests, and return the MR URL. Preview is available on request.
defaultPrompt: Create a verified GitLab merge request from my committed changes and return its URL.
Preview the GitLab merge request for this branch.
Verify the current managed merge request.
